description: Create an AppLovin creative set from uploaded asset ids, born PAUSED, optionally inside a campaign. It must hold EITHER an HTML playable OR a portrait image (IMG_INTER_P) plus a video; Hermoso checks that against AppLovin’s own asset types before creating it. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

brandInfo.description: override the account brand on THIS creative set — how a brand A/B tests the end card

campaignId.description: campaign to place the creative set in; optional

countries.description: ISO country codes for the creative set

url.description: landing page for this set only (WEB)

useAccountBrandInfo.description: true = go back to the account-level brand info

name: create_applovin_ads_creative_set
title: Create an AppLovin creative set (paused)
